# Apple Dumpling

Apple Dumpling is the pale-green Apple family mare you might remember making mountains of apple fritters alongside Apple Leaves. She is a minor speaking character in the official G4 *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity, not just an unnamed background pony.

[![Apple Dumpling, center-left, beside Apple Leaves — Hasbro Studios, Apple Family Reunion](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/19/1473167__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_apple%2Bcinnamon_apple%2Bdumpling_apple%2Bleaves_candy%2Bapples_earth%2Bpony_pony_apple%2Bfamily%2Breunion_apple%2Bfamily%2Bmem.png)](https://twibooru.org/1473167)

- **Appearance:** Light pistachio-green coat, two-tone crimson-pink mane and tail, teal eyes, and a dumpling with two apple slices as her cutie mark.
- **Name and voice:** Apple Dumpling is an official credited name, rather than a fandom invention. The [season-three credit transcription](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_three) identifies Ashleigh Ball, also Applejack's voice actor, as her English voice. The name is also used in Gameloft's licensed game; its [Sweet Apple Acres quests](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Sweet_Apple_Acres_quests) include Granny Smith welcoming her by name.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in *Apple Family Reunion* (S3E8, December 22, 2012); later seen in *Simple Ways* (S4E13) and *Trade Ya!* (S4E22). The [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Apple_Dumpling) also records her appearance in Applejack's nightmare in IDW's *Friendship Is Magic* #5, page 7, and her addition to the mobile game in June 2014. Diamond Tiara's use of “Apple Dumpling” for Apple Bloom in *Friends Forever* #16 refers to a different pony.

## Important moments

Both scenes are from [Apple Family Reunion (S3E8), official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7LwXctUyB0I); exact video timestamps could not be verified.

- **Catching up over fritters — Apple Family Reunion (S3E8).** She asks Apple Leaves, “You've got eight now, dont'cha?”, before Applejack interrupts to accelerate the baking, illustrating the episode's conflict between family conversation and excessive scheduling. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Apple_Family_Reunion).
- **Rebuilding the barn — Apple Family Reunion (S3E8).** After the disastrous hayride, she helps rebuild the barn during *Raise This Barn*, joining the family in the cooperative effort that salvages their reunion.

[![Apple Dumpling high on the barn frame — Hasbro Studios, Raise This Barn](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2025/4/18/3500037__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_apple%2Bbloom_apple%2Bbrown%2Bbetty_apple%2Bdumpling_apple%2Bfritter_apple%2Brose_applejack_big%2Bmcintosh_bushel_florina%2Bt.png)](https://twibooru.org/3500037)
